core_obligations: Reduce to the case where K is represented by a finite complex of finite free O_Y-modules, since a perfect module is locally of that form (proof lines 13922-13932).
Use an argument with stupid truncations to reduce the statement to the case where K is represented by a single finite free O_Y-module (proof lines 13933-13935).
Use invariance of the statement under finite direct summands in the K variable to reduce to K = O_Y[n], where the statement is trivial, and conclude (proof lines 13935-13938).
proof_roadmap: Make K a finite complex of finite free modules.
Cut it down to a single free module by stupid truncations.
Split off summands until K = O_Y[n] and conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma extends the projection formula Rf_*E tensor K = Rf_*(E tensor Lf^*K) from a finite locally free twist to an arbitrary perfect module K. The proof reduces to the case where K is represented by a finite complex of finite free modules, using that a perfect module is locally of that form; a simple argument with stupid truncations then reduces to K represented by a single finite free module, and invariance of the statement under finite direct summands in the K variable reduces further to K = O_Y[n], where the statement is trivial (proof lines 12922-13938 region, i.e. lines 13922-13938). H2: the truncation and direct-summand reductions are short but each is a genuine step, and together they give the full statement from the finite locally free case.
